about_the_game:
Pick up your screwdriver and wire cutters, rid the robots of their malfunctions, pains and nightmares.

This is a story-driven cyborg doctor simulation game.

These fragile mechanical lifeforms suffer from rejection, decay, and disease. As a doctor, your job is to patch them up—and send them back to work.

A strange calm hangs over your days—until it's shattered by a bizarre "Can Competition". Your patients will lead you deeper into the mystery, pulling you into a dangerous journey to uncover the hidden past and uncertain future of this robotic city.

Emotions encoded in data, pulsing through hard drives — a metaphor-laden narrative

  • A cargo bot powered by its own body

  • A drawing bot parasitized by AI

  • A bartender bot brewing liquor with tears

Each character is more than mere cold machinery, emotions and logical data flow through their modules, shattered memories carved in their magnetic tapes. Hack into them, experience their stories, and uncover the delicate emotions of these robots. Heal their "mechanical ghosts", or manipulate them through tampering and editing...

Just like choices and delimmas we encounter in our city life.

Heal with your screwdriver — an unique narative

Mechanical failures. Rejection syndromes. Emotional instability. Robots get sick too. Disassemble their bodies, dive into their circuitry, and heal them—just like fixing a machine.

Lofi & chill in a cyber city — a retro pixel audiovisual experience

There are moments of beauty even in this busy robotic city. Raindrops tapping on your bed. A sunset glimpsed from the overpass. A blurred silhouette from a memory long forgotten…

Turn off the lights. Let the pixels and melodies stir your thoughts.

How will the future unfold, will it be nice? — discover the secrets hidden in this robotic city.

Why would robots eat canned food? Where have humans gone? What is the ultimate purpose of a robot? And who’s pulling the strings? Uncover the answers to these questions in Love & Robot Repair. Your treatments and decisions may even shape the city's fate.

About Develpoer

We are Tin Bird — a team of drifters just like you, trying to make a living beneath the towering city.
In the noise of this steel jungle, we often feel numb — like machines slowly breaking down.
So we created these robots, and their stories.
We let them cry, laugh, struggle.
We let them feel confused, desperate.
And we let them try to love — and be loved.

We hope you’ll hear their voices in All Our Broken Parts.

And maybe, hear your *own* voice too.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i5-10600K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Experience a story-driven simulation game as a robot doctor. In a city of robots, illness is looming. Crack open ports and units to trace causes. Diagnose, repair and cross paths with robots and stories. Uncover secrets buried in the past and future, discover the truth that makes each robot unique.
